entities.name: FluC 2 (Q9K8L9)
observations: Exact sequence match (100% identity and coverage) to reviewed Halalkalibacterium halodurans UniProt Q9K8L9, annotated as a fluoride-specific ion channel.
Reference annotation: multipass cell-membrane channel involved in reducing intracellular fluoride and cellular fluoride detoxification.
Sequence length 134 aa; calculated unmodified molecular mass 14,381.8 Da and theoretical pI 9.78.
